channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Swiss Franc struggles as SNB dovish stance lifts USD/CHF
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 0.8310 during Asian hours on Monday. The currency pair is finding upward support as the Swiss Franc (CHF) remains under pressure from short positions.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Edges higher near 1.3250, but technical tone stays bearish below 100-day SMA
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3240 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the British Pound (GBP) as markets continue to assess the US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike path.

item.title: Australian Dollar fails ahead of 0.7000 as hawkish Fed and Iran risks limit USD losses
item.description: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick, trading below the 0.7000 psychological mark and below a nearly two-week high, touched earlier this Monday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Gets some relief from Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is marginally higher at around 1.1208 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Monday. The major currency pair gets slight relief from the announcement of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, which has put some pressure on oil prices.

item.title: Gold holds near one-week top, around $4,200 on softer USD; hawkish Fed caps gains
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some buyers for the third straight day, hitting an over one-week high during the Asian session on Monday, though it lacks follow-through.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Weakens to near 110.50, maintaining negative bias under 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 110.50 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD), with trading activity expected to remain subdued due to a national holiday in Japan.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rises to near 177.50 barrier near nine-day EMA
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground for the third successive day, trading around 177.40 during Asian hours on Monday. Liquidity would be thin, although it is the best opportunity for 'Yentervention'.

item.title: USD/INR drops 1% at open as RBI steps up measures to support Indian Rupee
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens significantly higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday. The USD/INR pair falls 1% to near 95.80 as Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) fresh measures to curb US Dollar demand has brought relief for the Indian currency.

item.title: IMF’s Georgieva says already seeing first wave of impact from AI
item.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said on Monday that she’s already seeing first wave of impact from Artificial Intelligence (AI).

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds gains near $61 amid Russia-Ukraine ceasefire
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades higher at around $61.10 in the Asian trade on Monday, holding onto Friday’s gains.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens as Middle East conflict elevates inflation risks
item.description: NZD/USD remains subdued for the second successive day, trading around 0.5610 during Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index drifts lower amid softer bond yields; bullish bias intact
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, attracts fresh sellers at the start of a new week, sliding back closer to the 102.00 mark during the Asian session.

item.title: India steps up currency defense with tougher US Dollar curbs — Reuters
item.description: India unveiled a new measures to boost the Indian Rupee (INR), redirecting oil companies' US Dollar purchases ‌away from the spot market and tightening hedging rules, Reuters reported on Saturday. The move comes as the domestic currency trades near record lows.

item.title: Gold drifts higher above $4,200 on surging ETF inflows, markets await US inflation data this week
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) gains ground to near $4,215 during the early Asian session on Monday. The precious metal extends the rally amid rising demand for bullion-backed exchange-traded funds and a weaker US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Canadian Dollar flat lines around 1.4250 as sliding oil prices counter USD softness
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on a modest gap-up open at the start of a new week, retreating back to mid-1.4200s during the Asian session.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds range amid Japanese holiday, dovish BoJ signals
item.description: USD/JPY depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous trading day, hovering around 158.10 during Asian hours on Monday. The pair may see limited movement due to thin trading conditions as Japanese markets are closed for the Sports Day public holiday.

item.title: British Pound gains positive traction as USD remains depressed on softer bond yields
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts some buyers for the third straight day, trading around mid-1.3200s during the Asians session on Monday, though it remains confined in a familiar range held over the past three weeks or so.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted Houthi ballistic missile toward Khamis Mushait
item.description: The Saudi-led military coalition said that it has intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Yemen's Houthis towards southern Saudi Arabia, the Time of Israel reported on Sunday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7313 vs. 6.7330 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7313 compared to Friday's fix of 6.7330 and 6.6977 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro holds gains above 1.1200 despite France’s bond turmoil
item.description: The EUR/USD pair recovers some lost ground to near 1.1215 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Euro (EUR) after weaker-than-expected US Consumer Sentiment data.

item.title: WTI declines to near $90.00 despite escalating Middle East conflict, supply risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) declines after two days of gains, trading around $90.00 per barrel during Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges higher to near 0.7000 on weak US Sentiment
item.description: The AUD/USD pair trades with mild gains around 0.6985 during the early Asian session on Monday. Softening US Consumer Sentiment weigh on the US Dollar (USD) against the Australian Dollar (AUD).

item.title: US President Donald Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to an ‘energy ceasefire’
item.description: US President Donald Trump claimed Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an ”energy ceasefire”, but he offered no details on it,the Guardian reported on Sunday.

item.title: Middle East War updates: New attack launched on Saudi airport
item.description: Here’s a brief recap of the key developments in the Middle East war that occurred over the weekend, which are expected to have a significant impact on markets in the upcoming week.

item.title: Aussie extends weekly gains as Fed pause bets offset hawkish rhetoric
item.description: The Aussie Dollar ended Friday’s session on a positive note, gaining 0.38% and 0.58% weekly as the US Dollar trimmed some of its weekly gains, while US data confirmed investors' expectations that the Federal Reserve would hold rates steady in the October meeting. The AUD/USD trades at 0.6983.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: PBoC defends yuan narrative – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s FX team highlights that the People’s Bank of China rejected claims the yuan is undervalued, linking export strength to industrial competitiveness rather than currency manipulation.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Range trading persists against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that USD/SGD remains supported within the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s policy band, with SGD NEER likely between 1.50% and 1.80% above midpoint, implying a 1.279–1.283 range. Short-term price action shows limited upward momentum, with resistance near 1.2835 and revised strong support at 1.2775.

item.title: Taiwan Dollar: Trade strength but losses capped against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts note Taiwan’s September trade surplus hit a record USD23.6bn, with exports surging 60.9% year-on-year on strong AI-related demand. The Central Bank of the Republic of China may lean more hawkish if inflation’s uptrend persists.

item.title: Crude Oil drops on Trump's Russian diesel plan
item.description: After a call with Russian President Putin, President Donald Trump said on Friday Russia will immediately supply more than 300K tons of diesel to the US and global markets. He put the next shipments at 500K tons in November and 1 million tons after that.
